common.availability: Computed only from observations timestamped within or before the interval; no future interval values.
common.missingness: No interpolation, forward-fill (except the explicitly stated funding state), or synthetic observations.

variables.formula: last_funding_rate at the greatest settlement calc_time <= interval_end; valid only when interval_end - calc_time is in [0, 12 hours]
variables.method_caveat: Repeated/discrete values are retained only for methods that validly support them; prior daily TE tie/atom gate is unchanged.
variables.semantics: Most recently settled funding rate available by the four-hour interval end. Repeated values reflect settlement cadence; no jitter.
variables.unit: native decimal funding rate per settlement interval

variables.availability_rule: interval close; requires adjacent valid intervals
variables.formula: log(oi_close_t / oi_close_{t-1}); oi_close is the final valid sum_open_interest snapshot in an interval, retained only if all 48 five-minute snapshots are valid
variables.method_caveat: The source's historical timestamp mapping is the Stage-1 certified mapping; this build applies that mapping and drops unmapped snapshots.
variables.semantics: Change in the provider-reported open-interest quantity; not a notional level.

variables.formula: (2 * sum(taker_buy_base_volume) - sum(base_volume)) / sum(base_volume), requiring positive denominator and all 48 five-minute bars
variables.method_caveat: The formula uses the certified kline fields; not a separate aggressor sell-volume feed.
variables.semantics: Binance USDⓈ-M perpetual kline taker-buy base-volume share transformed to signed imbalance.

variables.formula: log(spot_close_t / spot_close_{t-1}); spot_close is the last valid five-minute close in the four-hour interval
variables.method_caveat: Same-venue Binance spot represents venue-specific conditions, not global spot.
variables.semantics: Binance BTCUSDT or ETHUSDT spot return.

variables.formula: sqrt(sum(r_5m_j^2 for the 48 within-interval five-minute close-to-close log returns))
variables.method_caveat: The first five-minute return uses the immediately preceding cached five-minute close.
variables.semantics: Intraday realized volatility, requiring all 48 interval returns and complete bars.

variables.formula: sum(min(r_5m_j, 0)^2 for the 48 within-interval five-minute close-to-close log returns)
variables.method_caveat: Requires all 48 interval returns and complete bars.
variables.semantics: Realized downside semivariance from negative five-minute returns only.

variables.formula: 1e6 * abs(spot_return) / spot_quote_volume, requiring positive four-hour quote_volume
variables.method_caveat: USDT quote volume is not asserted to equal USD volume.
variables.semantics: Same-pair Binance spot Amihud proxy; fixed readability multiplier 1e6.
variables.unit: scaled absolute four-hour log return per USDT quote-volume unit

variables.formula: (2 * sum(taker_buy_base_volume) - sum(base_volume)) / sum(base_volume), requiring positive denominator and all 48 five-minute bars
variables.method_caveat: The formula uses the certified kline fields; not a separate aggressor sell-volume feed.
variables.semantics: Binance spot kline taker-buy base-volume share transformed to signed imbalance.

variables.availability_rule: interval close; requires adjacent positive-volume intervals
variables.formula: log(spot_quote_volume_t) - log(spot_quote_volume_{t-1}); both four-hour quote volumes must be positive
variables.method_caveat: USDT quote units are retained as reported; no USD conversion is implied.
variables.semantics: Change in Binance BTCUSDT or ETHUSDT spot quote volume.

variables.formula: mean(mark_price_close_j / index_price_close_j - 1 for 48 matched five-minute observations)
variables.method_caveat: Retained as an optional secondary feature; it is not a funding rate or annualized futures basis.
variables.semantics: Four-hour mean of the contemporaneous Binance futures mark/index premium.
